verdict.rationale: Metronome is a usage-based billing SaaS platform, and a built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for that kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only covers APIs, SDKs, webhooks, integrations and the UI event explorer, with nothing about an in-product AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The llms.txt and OpenAPI probes make the docs machine-readable but are not a built-in assistant.
